In this video: Lenin turns to expanding the network of cooperative enterprises throughout Russia in order to engage the peasantry in the task of building socialism. He contrasts in detail the concept of building cooperatives under capitalism, which is utopian and fantastical without waging class struggle against the bourgeoisie more directly, with building them under socialism, when the land and means of production have been nationalized.

The original text is here: https://www.marxists.org/archive/lenin/works/1923/jan/06.htm
